tolerance_classes.EXACT_VALUE: integers, strings, enums, booleans, null, statuses, error classes / messages, key sets and order, and floats that are copied (not computed): equal (floats by bit pattern)
tolerance_classes.ULP_BOUNDED: |rust - py| <= k_ulp * ulp(py); ulp(py) = 2^(floor(log2|py|) - 52) for normal py, the smallest subnormal for py = 0 or subnormal py; no relative or absolute clause
tolerance_classes.EXACT_STREAM: not used (no RNG in either implementation)

tolerance_basis.independence: fixed before any comparison from the operation list
tolerance_basis.registered: k_ulp = 4 (template proposal). Every computed value is a chain of IEEE-754 basic operations (*, +, -) evaluated in the reference order by both implementations; Rust performs no floating-point contraction, so bit identity is expected and the report states the bit-identical count

decision_rules.per_test: every scored observable of every vector meets its tolerance class; every outcome / error class / message equals the reference outcome (or the registered DIV-A-01 outcome)
decision_rules.verdict: ADMITTED iff every per-test, invariant, domain/error and schema check passes and every reference file matches sha256_at_registration; PARITY_PASS <=> ADMITTED, PARITY_FAIL <=> NOT_ADMITTED
decision_rules.meaning_of_ADMITTED: A9.24 item 1: Rust becomes authoritative for this component (within the registered domain); new production results for it come from Rust and carry implementation = rust, rust_commit and this contract id; the Python component may then be retired from active execution. It is NOT physics validation, and the reference drag stays REFERENCE/PARAMETRIC with freeze_status NOT_EVALUATED (S6.18: AG-13 closure needs the host-spacecraft ICD).
decision_rules.no_retuning: tolerances, observables, inputs, n, seeds and rules are fixed; after NOT_ADMITTED only a code fix plus a new contract version with a fresh scoring_master_seed may follow; the failed report stays; no execution is discarded
decision_rules.disagreement_rule: never rewrite a Python result, golden, fixture or frozen dataset to make Rust pass (RM-R11)
decision_rules.observable_scope: observables are restricted to retained selected-architecture physics; no observable depends on an excluded legacy path (RM-R20)
decision_rules.scoring_once: the scoring comparison runs once (scoring_master_seed); the harness refuses a second scoring run when parity_report_v1.json exists; development runs never write a report
